summary: Phase 4 candidate completed the confirmed CI and quality-gate work. The CI backend job now creates web/dist, web/classic/dist, and web/canvas/dist embed placeholders. With local ignored placeholders, root and relaykit vet/build passed; relaykit tests passed. Frontend typecheck, production build, 278 frontend tests, focused wallet/groupbuy/auth tests (67), i18n sync, router/middleware/controller tests, and lint on the affected wallet files passed. Full root Go tests still expose two deterministic pre-existing service/channel_affinity_usage_cache failures; the full run also had one Windows HTTP/2 retry failure that passes in isolation. Full frontend lint still has unrelated classic and existing default errors. Real merchant payment remains online-only and WeChat login remains paused.
